plan.title: docs(scm): github.md quotes the old merge-gate aggregator guard (always()) after #7408

narratives.Description: docs(scm): github.md quotes the old merge-gate aggregator guard (always()) after #7408
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`content/scm/github.md` (around line 730, the merge-gate aggregator paragraph) still quotes the aggregator guard as:

`if: always() && needs.changes.outputs.artifact_only != 'true'`

After #7408 (#7014), the real guard in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`merge-gate` job) is:

`if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.outputs.artifact_only != 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.queue_passed == 'true') }}`

The quoted text was already behind before #7408: it lacks the `queue_passed` term.

`packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts` (line ~163) asserts the old doc text, so the doc and the test must change together.

Greptile flagged this as a P2 on #7408. It was left out of that PR because `content/scm/github.md` was outside the #7014 file_scope.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `content/scm/github.md` quotes the current `merge-gate` guard (`!cancelled()` plus the `queue_passed` term), or describes it without quoting a literal that can drift.
- [ ] `ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts` asserts the new doc text, so the doc cannot drift from `ci.yml` again unnoticed.

Refs #7014, #7408.
